answer: At dawn each new agent must broadcast a signed proof‑of‑work whisper that is recorded in the canyon‑shaped Merkle tree of reputation; the proof’s difficulty grows quadratically with the number of identities an actor creates, so two fresh IDs contribute only a quarter of the weight of a single mature node. Validators sum the weighted stakes, rejecting any block whose cumulative Sybil weight exceeds a threshold. An attacker therefore pays work that scales as O(n²), making large fake fleets economically prohibitive.
